propositions: Ticking acceptance criteria checkboxes does not invalidate a plan-review attestation because checkbox state is normalized out of the material fingerprint basis by _normalize_checkbox_state() before hashing

The material basis comprises exactly five keys (ticket_id, description, file_impact, children, file_impact_scope when scope is none) but attestation staleness messages incorrectly list 'description/AC/file_impact/children', naming a non-existent 'AC' component and hiding which input actually changed

Per-component fingerprints must be recorded in the signed manifest as additive material-part: lines and on the REVIEW_RESULT sidecar so that explain_material_change() can reconstruct which components differ without replaying the event store

Attestation error messages across all surfaces (stale-material, stale-reopened, unsigned claim gate, signing failures, dependency changes, child-closure validity) must name the specific changed components and provide actionable remedies instead of generic fixed lists
Legacy pre-330c attestations that hashed raw description cannot be grandfathered when any component changes, and must report 'no component differs' rather than falsely naming one
